scope: NBA regular-season completed games only; ESPN team schedules and box scores
season_year_semantics: NBA season ending year; 2026 is 2025-26, the latest complete season as of 2026-10-21
adjusted_extra_feature: expected missing rolling box-score production: away loss minus home loss
rating: Hollinger Game Score per 36 minutes from last 30 prior appearances, empirical league-mean shrinkage of 200 minutes, withheld below 100 observed minutes; clearly a production proxy, not causal adjusted plus/minus
replacement: prior-only 25th percentile of eligible player production per 36; projected missing minutes redistributed to observed teammates subject to 48-minute capacity; unknown rating remains unknown
historical_availability: derive participation/DNP/inactive/missing from box scores; use only prior-game participation to estimate next-game absence risk. Current-game DNPs are postgame outcomes and NEVER pregame features. No claim of confirmed historical injury labels.
lagged_absence_probability: Beta(1,1) smoothed observed previous-zero-minute to next-zero-minute transition using games before prediction date; game-specific official statuses unavailable in historical training
chronology: All features computed before processing any results on the same America/New_York calendar date. Rolling ratings, team membership, minutes and replacement levels use past records only. Full-season stats and present-day rosters prohibited in historical features.
elo: 1500 initialization, K=20, 0.75 season carryover toward 1500; fixed before evaluation
selection: L2 logistic regression; C grid [0.1,1,10]. Select lowest validation log loss separately per model, refit on 2023-2025, evaluate once on 2026. Adjusted missing-production coefficient constrained nonnegative for monotonic response to lost production. No probability post-calibration fit on test.
live_unknown_statuses: Show full/absent scenarios and empirical lagged participation probability. No invented Questionable/Probable conversion percentages. Official Out=0 participation; Available=1. Uncertain labels use observed lagged base rate with explicit uncalibrated-status warning.
test_reporting: Report both models even if adjusted loses; metrics concern lagged availability proxy, not a backtest of official injury adjustments. Live official overrides are a domain shift and unvalidated separately.
data_failure: retain cached normalized records and source hashes; disclose coverage, omit invalid game labels, never synthesize scores or player stats
